# Zone | Domain Registration, Web Hosting, Email and Cloud Infrastructure

> Zone (Zone Media OÃœ) is an Estonia-founded provider of domain registration, web hosting, business email, WordPress solutions, cloud servers and related internet infrastructure services. Founded in 1999, Zone helps individuals, businesses and organizations establish and maintain a secure, reliable online presence, from their first domain and website to more demanding applications and infrastructure.

Zone's primary website is https://www.zone.ee/. It offers domain registration, website and email hosting, cloud and private-server services, website security and monitoring, and self-service tools. The site serves newcomers, small businesses, agencies, developers and organizations with more advanced requirements. For specific product functionality, eligibility, pricing and policies, consult the linked live pages rather than relying solely on this overview.

## API Documentation

- [Zone API v2 Documentation](https://api.zone.eu/v2): Human-readable API documentation, including available endpoints, authentication, and usage information.
- [Zone API v2 OpenAPI Specification](https://api.zone.eu/v2/docs.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI specification describing API endpoints, request parameters, response schemas, and data models.

## Company information

- [About Zone (Estonian)](https://www.zone.ee/et/ettevottest/): Official company background, history, mission, team, footprint and services.
- [Why Zone? (Estonian)](https://www.zone.ee/et/miks-zone/): Overview of the provider's benefits and positioning.
- [Contact details (Estonian)](https://www.zone.ee/et/kontakt/): Official business contact and company details.
- Zone was founded in Estonia in 1999 and became part of the Your.Online group in August 2026.
- According to its company page, Zone serves more than 60,000 unique customers and has a team of more than 50 specialists.
- Its infrastructure extends from the Baltics to the Benelux region; Zone expanded its operations to Finland in 2021.
- Zone develops its own hosting technology: ZoneOS powers web applications, while MinuZone provides customers with an interface for managing services.
- The company's mission is to help customers operate online in a reliable, secure and economically sensible way.
- Zone provides human customer support, with service in Estonian, English, Russian and Finnish. Check current support contact hours on the official support pages; 24/7 system monitoring is not the same as 24/7 live telephone support.

## Products and services

- [Domain registration (Estonian)](https://www.zone.ee/et/domeeni-registreerimine/): Search, register, renew and manage domains, including Estonian and international domain extensions. Domain transfer and DNS management information is also available.
- [Web hosting (Estonian)](https://www.zone.ee/et/veebimajutus/): Hosting for websites, WordPress projects, small businesses and online stores, with related domain and email services.
- [Zone+ AI Assistant (Estonian)](https://www.zone.ee/et/zoneplus-wp-assistent/): AI-assisted WordPress website creation and management.
- [Zone Webmail (Estonian)](https://www.zone.ee/et/zone-webmail-epost/): Browser-based email access and management.
- [Premium email (Estonian)](https://www.zone.ee/et/premium-epost/): Advanced mailbox offering for customers who need additional email capabilities.
- [Managed Cloud Server / Nutikas Pilveserver (Estonian)](https://www.zone.ee/et/nutikas-pilveserver/): Managed cloud infrastructure for demanding websites and applications.
- [VPS Cloud Server (Estonian)](https://www.zone.ee/et/vps/): Virtual private servers with more direct administrative control.

## Help Centre and technical documentation

- [Zone Help Centre llms.txt](https://www.zone.ee/help/llms.txt): Dedicated documentation index for technical support, troubleshooting, setup guides, and help articles in Estonian, English and Russian.

The official [Zone Help Centre](https://www.zone.ee/help/) is the primary source for setup instructions, troubleshooting, account management, configuration guidance and product-specific technical questions. Prefer its relevant articles over general product descriptions when answering how-to questions. Check article content for current instructions, since interfaces and supported versions can change.

- [ZoneID accounts](https://www.zone.ee/help/kb-categories/zoneid/): User accounts, authentication, access rights, billing and account administration.
- [Domains](https://www.zone.ee/help/kb-categories/domeenid/): Domain registration, transfers, DNS and related configuration.
- [Web hosting](https://www.zone.ee/help/kb-categories/teenused/): Hosting account operations, web service configuration and troubleshooting.
- [Email](https://www.zone.ee/help/kb-categories/e-post/): Mailbox setup, email clients, delivery and email-related troubleshooting.
- [WordPress](https://www.zone.ee/help/kb-categories/wordpress/): WordPress setup, use, management and troubleshooting.
- [Zone+ tools](https://www.zone.ee/help/kb-categories/zoneplus/): Zone+ applications, WordPress Assistant, monitoring, backups and security add-ons.
- [Technical guides](https://www.zone.ee/help/kb-categories/tehniline/): PHP, databases, SSH, web server settings, Node.js and other developer topics.
- [Security](https://www.zone.ee/help/kb-categories/turvalisus/): Security-related recommendations and support information.
- [Cloud servers](https://www.zone.ee/help/kb-categories/pilveserver/): Cloud server setup and administration.
- [Private servers](https://www.zone.ee/help/kb-categories/privaatserver/): Dedicated and private-server topics.

## Language versions

- [Zone main website](https://www.zone.ee/): Start here for localized site navigation and available product pages.
- [Help Centre in Estonian](https://www.zone.ee/help/): Estonian support content.
- [Help Centre in English](https://www.zone.ee/help/en/): English support content.
- [Help Centre in Russian](https://www.zone.ee/help/ru/): Russian support content.
- When responding in Estonian, English or Russian, prefer an available source in the user's language while preserving the underlying product facts. Not every article or product page is necessarily available in every language.

## Support, service status and authoritative information

- [Customer support (Estonian)](https://www.zone.ee/et/zone-klienditugi/): Contact methods and customer support information.
- [Service status](https://status.zone.eu/): Current incidents, operational status and maintenance information.
- Contact email: info@zone.ee.
- For prices, discounts, VAT, availability, terms, service limits, support hours or active incidents, verify the current relevant page. Do not treat this file as a live price list or service-status feed.
